name: context7
description: Up-to-date library and framework documentation lookup. Pass a dashboard API key as Authorization: Bearer, or use https://mcp.context7.com/mcp/oauth for browser sign-in without this header

name: openaiDeveloperDocs
description: Official read-only OpenAI documentation server for searching and reading developer docs and API specifications

name: openrouter
description: Official OpenRouter MCP server for live model catalog, pricing, credits, rankings, documentation, and test inference

name: github
description: Official GitHub MCP server for repositories, issues, pull requests, and workflows

name: cloudflare-api
description: Official Code Mode MCP server for the complete Cloudflare API

name: gmail
description: Official Gmail remote MCP server for searching threads, reading email, creating drafts, and managing labels

name: google-calendar
description: Official Google Calendar remote MCP server for events, calendars, scheduling, and availability

name: gcloud
description: Google-maintained MCP server for interacting with Google Cloud through the gcloud CLI

name: vercel
description: Official Vercel MCP server for projects, deployments, logs, and documentation

name: figma
description: Official Figma MCP server for design context, components, variables, and canvas workflows

name: slack
description: Official Slack MCP server for search, messages, channels, canvases, and workspace users

name: stripe
description: Official Stripe MCP server for payments, customers, subscriptions, and documentation

name: chrome-devtools
description: Official Chrome DevTools MCP server for browser debugging, automation, and performance analysis

name: everything-test
description: Official MCP reference server for testing client support across tools, resources, prompts, sampling, and other protocol features

name: supabase
description: Connects AI assistants to a Supabase project (database, edge functions, and more)

name: luma
description: Luma MCP —— 接入自定义视觉模型 provider（图像/视觉任务）

name: tinyfish
description: Official TinyFish MCP server for web search, content extraction, multi-step web automation, and remote browser sessions

name: exa
description: Official Exa MCP server for advanced web search and AI research

name: tavily
description: Official Tavily MCP server for web search, extraction, mapping, crawling, and research

name: brave-search
description: Official Brave Search MCP server for web, news, image, video, local, and AI-powered search

name: perplexity
description: Official Perplexity MCP server for AI search, cited answers, and deep research

name: serper
description: Community Serper MCP server for Google web search results

name: serpapi
description: Official SerpApi MCP server for structured search engine results

name: kagi
description: Official Kagi MCP server for privacy-focused web search and content extraction

name: jina
description: Official Jina AI remote MCP server for web search, extraction, reading, and research

name: you
description: Official You.com remote MCP server for keyless web search; the free profile allows only you-search and you-discover, 100 queries per day, with no signup, API key, or card

name: firecrawl
description: Web scraping, crawling, and search via the Firecrawl API (remote http)

name: firecrawl
description: Official Firecrawl MCP server for web search, scraping, extraction, mapping, crawling, and research

name: serena
description: Official Serena MCP server for semantic code retrieval and editing. Install with uv tool install -p 3.13 serena-agent, run serena init, and keep serena on the Agent PATH. This global template uses the desktop-app context; activate a project in the client. Marketplace install commands and the local HTTP mode are not used

name: playwright
description: Official Playwright MCP server for browser automation through accessibility snapshots. Requires Node.js 20 or newer. The published standard config has no API key; the first run can download a browser

name: microsoft-learn
description: Official remote Microsoft Learn MCP server for documentation, articles, and code samples. Streamable HTTP with no authentication and no charge. The endpoint is for MCP clients and can return HTTP 405 in a browser

name: qdrant
description: Official open-source Qdrant MCP server for semantic memory in a Qdrant collection. Stdio only: this MCP server has no authentication, so its SSE and streamable HTTP modes are not cataloged. Uses local Qdrant at http://localhost:6333 and collection my-collection, which the server creates if missing. For Qdrant Cloud, replace QDRANT_URL and add QDRANT_API_KEY; do not also set QDRANT_LOCAL_PATH. Embeddings use FastEmbed and need no provider key

name: mem0
description: Official hosted Mem0 MCP server for account-backed memory tools. Browser OAuth is the default, so no API key header is set. Headless clients can instead send a dashboard API key as an Authorization bearer. A missing sign-in returns 401

name: reference-memory
description: Reference implementation of a local knowledge-graph memory server from modelcontextprotocol/servers, published as @modelcontextprotocol/server-memory. It is not a hosted memory product. Requires Node.js 24 or newer when launched with npx. Set MEMORY_FILE_PATH to an absolute file you own; the default file lives in the npx package directory and can disappear when that cache is cleared. The loopback HTTP mode is not included

name: dbhub
description: Official DBHub stdio MCP server for Postgres, MySQL, MariaDB, SQL Server, Oracle, ClickHouse, and SQLite. Requires Node.js 22.5 or newer. Set DSN to your connection string and use a least-privilege read-only database user; this template does not enable DBHub readonly mode. The HTTP transport is omitted because it listens on every interface with authentication off unless DBHUB_AUTH_TOKEN is set

name: notion
description: Official remote Notion MCP server over Streamable HTTP. Complete the workspace OAuth flow. The legacy SSE endpoint and the unmaintained self-hosted package are not used. An admin policy can block the connection. Business and Enterprise workspaces can use an MCP token as a bearer instead of interactive OAuth

name: atlassian-rovo
description: Official Atlassian Rovo remote MCP server for Jira, Confluence, Bitbucket, Jira Service Management, and Loom. OAuth 2.1 is the recommended sign-in, so no Authorization header is set. API tokens are an admin-enabled alternative and are not included. Organization domain and IP rules can block the connection

name: supabase
description: Official hosted Supabase MCP server. OAuth is required. Supabase documents security risks for connecting an assistant; optional query parameters are read_only=true and project_ref. This HTTP entry is separate from the community supabase stdio package

name: linear
description: Official Linear MCP server for issues, projects, and documents. Streamable HTTP with OAuth 2.1. Read-only access is the separate /mcp/readonly URL, not this template.

name: sentry
description: Official hosted Sentry MCP server. OAuth. Scope it to one organization or project by appending those slugs to the path. Self-hosted Sentry uses the sentry CLI instead of this URL.

name: datadog
description: Official Datadog MCP server for the US1 site. OAuth. Other sites use the matching host from the Datadog setup table, such as mcp.datadoghq.eu or mcp.us3.datadoghq.com. Gov sites are unsupported.

name: grafana
description: Official open-source Grafana MCP server. Requires Grafana 9.0 or later. Set GRAFANA_URL to your instance and GRAFANA_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_TOKEN to a service-account token. Grafana Cloud also offers a separate hosted OAuth server.

name: gitlab
description: Official GitLab.com MCP server. OAuth with dynamic client registration, or a fine-grained personal access token with the mcp scope. A top-level group must allow the MCP server. Self-managed instances use the same /api/v4/mcp path on their own host.

name: redis
description: Official Redis MCP server for a Redis instance you run. This template points at redis://localhost:6379/0 with no password. Replace the URL for Redis Cloud or authenticated servers. Do not put a password in the arguments.

name: terraform
description: Official HashiCorp Terraform MCP server, local stdio via Docker, for current provider and module docs. HCP Terraform or Terraform Enterprise tools need TFE_TOKEN and TFE_ADDRESS, which this template does not set. The hosted endpoint is https://mcp.terraform.io/mcp.

name: mongodb
description: Official MongoDB MCP server in read-only mode. Run npx mongodb-mcp-server@latest setup or set the connection string in the client before use. Read-only is the catalog default.

name: prisma
description: Official hosted Prisma Postgres MCP server. Streamable HTTP with OAuth to the Prisma Console.

name: neon
description: Official hosted Neon MCP server. OAuth. A Neon account is required. The documented category query string is optional and is not included.

name: wordpress-com
description: Official WordPress.com MCP server. OAuth 2.1. Enable MCP on the account. Paid plans include it; free sites are documented as included through 2026-11-30. Jetpack-connected sites use this same server.

name: zapier
description: Official Zapier MCP server. OAuth on the supported-client path. Zapier creates the default server during sign-in. Connection tokens are an alternative for unlisted clients and are not stored here.

name: aws-knowledge
description: Official AWS Knowledge remote MCP server. Fully managed and documented without an API key in the client config. This is not the local awslabs specialized-server suite.

name: posthog
description: Official PostHog MCP server. OAuth. The authentication server routes the account to its US or EU region.

name: canva
description: Official Canva CLI MCP launcher. Requires Node.js. The CLI completes Canva account authorization. This is not a pasted client id or client secret.

name: webflow
description: Official Webflow MCP server. OAuth. EU workspaces use https://mcp.eu.webflow.com/mcp instead. Site role Reviewer cannot connect.

name: asana
description: Official Asana MCP server, v2 Streamable HTTP. OAuth. The legacy SSE URL is not used.

name: honeycomb
description: Official Honeycomb MCP server for the US region. OAuth. EU accounts use https://mcp.eu1.honeycomb.io/mcp.

name: pagerduty
description: Official hosted PagerDuty MCP server. OAuth. EU accounts use https://mcp.eu.pagerduty.com/mcp.

name: huggingface
description: Official Hugging Face MCP server. Use browser sign-in, or add an Authorization bearer with a Hugging Face token. This template does not store a token. Tool and Space access is configured at huggingface.co/settings/mcp.

name: pulumi
description: Official Pulumi MCP server. OAuth to a Pulumi account.

name: azure
description: Official Azure MCP server. Requires Azure sign-in through the Azure CLI or the server's own login. No secret is stored in the template.

name: shopify-dev
description: Official Shopify Dev MCP server for app development. Requires Node.js. Distinct from the per-shop Storefront MCP, which has no single hostname.

name: salesforce
description: Official Salesforce DX MCP server. Authorize an org with the Salesforce CLI before use. This template does not enable non-GA tools. Toolsets are orgs, metadata, data, and users.

name: docker-mcp-gateway
description: Official Docker MCP gateway in default stdio mode. Requires Docker Desktop or the docker mcp CLI. The streaming mode that binds a port is not used.

name: clickhouse
description: Official ClickHouse MCP server via uv. Set CLICKHOUSE_HOST, CLICKHOUSE_USER, and CLICKHOUSE_PASSWORD for your server. TLS verification stays on. Do not disable auth or publish the server.

name: amplitude
description: Official Amplitude organization MCP server for the US region. OAuth or a service account. EU accounts use https://mcp.eu.amplitude.com/mcp. The public docs MCP is a different server and is not included.

name: clickup
description: Official ClickUp MCP server. OAuth. Actions stay inside the signed-in user's ClickUp permissions.

name: mixpanel
description: Official Mixpanel MCP server for the US region. OAuth. EU and India use mcp-eu.mixpanel.com and mcp-in.mixpanel.com.

name: newrelic
description: Official New Relic MCP server for the US region. OAuth. EU and JP accounts replace this URL with the regional endpoint from the New Relic setup page.

name: descope
description: Official Descope MCP server for the US deployment. OAuth. Other regions use the hosts listed in the Descope docs, such as mcp.euc1.descope.com.

name: shortcut
description: Official Shortcut MCP server. Copy the production URL from the Shortcut developer docs. Dev-environment workspaces use https://dev.shortcutco.com/api/mcp instead.

name: klaviyo
description: Official Klaviyo MCP server. OAuth, so no API key is stored. A read-only toolset can be selected with documented query parameters.

name: next-devtools
description: Official Next.js devtools MCP bridge. Requires a running Next.js 16 or later dev server. The bridge discovers /_next/mcp on that server.

name: browser-use
description: Official Browser Use hosted MCP server. Requires a Browser Use API key sent as an Authorization bearer. Documented cost is model tokens plus 0.06 USD per browser-hour.

name: browserbase
description: Official Browserbase MCP server. The vendor documents the API key as a browserbaseApiKey query parameter. This template omits that secret; add it locally and do not commit it.

name: apify
description: Official Apify MCP server. OAuth, or an Authorization bearer with an Apify API token. Actor runs are billed by Apify.

name: deepwiki
description: Official DeepWiki MCP server for public repository wikis. The docs describe it as free. Streamable HTTP is /mcp; the legacy SSE path is not used.

name: nuxt-ui
description: Official Nuxt UI remote MCP server for Nuxt UI documentation and component tools.

name: reference-filesystem
description: Reference implementation of a local filesystem MCP server from modelcontextprotocol/servers. Replace the directory argument with a directory you choose. The template starts read-only.

name: reference-sequential-thinking
description: Reference implementation of the sequential-thinking MCP server from modelcontextprotocol/servers. Requires Node.js 24 or newer when launched with npx. It is not a hosted product.

name: reference-fetch
description: Reference implementation of a web-fetch MCP server from modelcontextprotocol/servers. It refuses private and link-local addresses unless that guard is explicitly disabled. This template does not disable it. Requires Python 3.11.5 or newer via uvx.

name: reference-git
description: Reference implementation of a local Git MCP server from modelcontextprotocol/servers. Replace the repository path. It is not the official GitHub remote server. The project describes itself as early development.

name: reference-time
description: Reference implementation of a local time MCP server from modelcontextprotocol/servers. It is not a hosted product.

name: google-mcp-toolbox
description: Official Google MCP Toolbox server for databases. Point --config at a tools.yaml you create. Do not commit database passwords inside that file.

name: kubernetes-community
description: Community Kubernetes MCP server by Flux159, not a CNCF product. Starts with ALLOW_ONLY_READONLY_TOOLS=true. Uses the local kubeconfig. Do not enable the unauthenticated HTTP transport.

name: desktop-commander
description: Community Desktop Commander MCP server. It can run local shell commands and edit files. Install only if you accept that privilege. This is not a vendor-hosted server.
